newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank ask-only in Tokyo on stock issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank ask-only in Tokyo on stock issue plan.

text.p: Shares in Asahi Bank Ltd were ask-only in early Tokyo trading on Wednesday on news that it plans to issue preferred stocks worth 100 billion yen, brokers said.
As of 0013 GMT, the share was ask-only at 880 yen, compared with its Tuesday close of 890 yen.
After the Tokyo stock market closed on Tuesday, the top Japanese commercial bank said it plans to issue 100 billion yen worth of preferred stock overseas.

It said the planned issue of 50 million preferred shares was designed to bolster its financial strength and make its business base more solid. The preferred shares will be priced at 2,000 each, and the payment date is August 7.
